title: Maximum odd Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $f$ be a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube. Its nonnegative odd Fourier maximum is the largest of $0$ and the Fourier coefficients of $f$, viewed as real-valued, indexed by odd-cardinality frequencies.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $n$ specifying the cube dimension
